app.name: Product name. Do not translate.
btn.copy: Button that copies text to the clipboard.
btn.print: Button on the quick sheet (web): opens the browser print dialog.
btn.restart_later: Button in the restart-to-switch-layout prompt; 'Later' as in 'not now'.
btn.save: Button that saves the paper on the phone.
btn.stop: Button that stops the voice reading aloud.
card.plan: Card title for the numbered list of steps.
clerk.generic_need: Completes the sentence 'I need help with …' on the card shown to a clerk.
clerk.preset.form: Completes 'I need help with …'; the clerk reads it in English.
confidence.high: Label on a fact the app could confirm on the page; 'Clear' as in certain, not as in transparent.
confidence.medium: Label on a fact the app is fairly sure about.
demand.estimate_prefix: Prefix before an estimated date; keep the colon.
demand.rule_link: Tiny link label next to an estimated date; keep the arrow symbol.
demo.as_of_note: One line on sample-paper results. The sample papers have fixed dates; the app shows their dates as if today were this date. Keep the date and year digits exactly.
emergency.kind.poison: Noun inserted into 'I saw words about {kinds} on this paper.'
langpack.adapting: Loading message shown while the app is being translated into the user's language.
quicksheet.bring: Section title in the quick sheet: things to bring to the office.
quicksheet.title_suffix: Appended after the document title in the PDF file name and header; keep the leading dash.
reminders.off: Toggle state: reminders are turned off.
reminders.on: Toggle state: reminders are turned on.
reminders.past: Label on a reminder whose date has already passed.
resource.free: Cost label: the service costs nothing.
resource.sliding: Cost label: the price depends on your income.
review.document_hint: Label before the guessed document type, e.g. 'I think this is a… Medicaid letter'.
review.remove: Button that removes one page from the scan.
review.rotate: Button that rotates a page image by 90 degrees.
settings.licenses: Settings row that opens the list of open-source licenses (fonts and packages). Noun.
settings.reading: Section title in Settings for reading-aloud and text options.
settings.tone_formal: Option name for polite, formal wording.
source.unclear: Marker inserted where a word could not be read; keep the square brackets.
state.cached: Small label on a list that was saved earlier and may be out of date.
state.no_local: Shown in Get help when no verified local organizations exist for the user's area.
tabs.help: Bottom tab: nearby help and resources.
tabs.papers: Bottom tab: the user's saved papers (family vault).
urgency.word.high: Short urgency label: act within days.
urgency.word.info: Short urgency label for a paper with nothing urgent.
urgency.word.medium: Short urgency label: act within weeks.
warning.contacts_stripped_inline: Replaces a phone number or link inside a sentence; keep the square brackets.
